findings.title: v0.2 does not yet encode a falsifiable experiment
findings.resolution: v0.2 is explicitly an engineering nucleus. Scientific self-improvement claims are blocked until versioned ExperimentSpec, evaluator, result, preregistration, and statistical protocols exist.

findings.title: Proposed harness comparisons are causally confounded
findings.resolution: No causal harness ranking or improvement claim is permitted from v0.2 runs. Matched model, tools, information, turns, tokens, compute, and cost remain required.

findings.title: Sealed-holdout and contamination claims cannot currently be supported
findings.resolution: Confirmatory evaluation is blocked until an external Crucible keeps hidden labels and holdouts outside worker-visible mounts and egress.

findings.title: The final gate oracle can report readiness without proving it
findings.resolution: summary-v02 now requires exact unique G1-G15 checked blocks with non-pending evidence and emits a digest over the reviewed source and evidence files; the external gate runner re-executes every gate.

findings.title: Adapter behavior is not fail-closed
findings.resolution: Unknown and unsupported versions now fail before planning, reviewed compatibility prefixes and executable fingerprints bind the plan, and negative controls enforce both cases. Full live conformance for every provider-backed adapter remains a public and sensitive-data blocker.

findings.title: The advertised comparison unit is not represented at runtime
findings.resolution: v0.2 cannot make comparative or scientific attribution claims. Experiment identity, provider/model revision, sampling, tools, usage, cost, trials, and evaluators are required in a later ExperimentSpec tranche.

findings.title: The final gate oracle can report success with unmet gates
findings.resolution: The final oracle parses exact gate blocks, requires G1-G15 checked with evidence, binds results to a source digest, and is itself re-executed by the gate runner.

findings.title: Read-only does not protect readable data or credentials
findings.resolution: The child environment is cleared to a narrow baseline, but readable file credentials and shared egress remain. Use is restricted to a disposable VM or dedicated non-sensitive account with scoped credentials; public, persistent, multi-user, and write-capable modes are blocked.

findings.title: Current observability cannot support defensible harness comparisons
findings.resolution: No defensible comparison claim is allowed in v0.2. The signed plan, worker version/fingerprint, genome digest, task/output hashes, duration, and isolation are engineering evidence only.

findings.title: Inspected plans are not bound to execution
findings.resolution: Execution now requires the exact digest from a separately inspected deterministic plan, rechecks the worker fingerprint, verifies a signed current genome, and records all digests in Bloodline.

findings.title: Release readiness is not a trustworthy oracle
findings.resolution: Release readiness now requires owner-ratified licensing metadata, complete gates, structured review approval, third-party notices, SBOM, protected release approval, and reproducibility evidence. v0.2 remains blocked by its disposition and missing license.

findings.title: Untrusted Skill source traversal remains
findings.resolution: Skill reads now reject every symlink component and use Linux openat2 with BENEATH, NO_MAGICLINKS, and NO_SYMLINKS. Direct and nested SKILL.md symlink adversarial tests fail closed.

findings.title: The independent-review gate is syntactic, not dispositive
findings.resolution: Each review now has a schema-validated independent record. Acceptance requires all five roles, unique finding IDs, complete disposition coverage, blocked status for unresolved findings, and propagation of a non-approving verdict.

findings.title: External-effect denial is not independently enforceable
findings.resolution: Environment inheritance was removed, but remote actions through readable credentials and shared network remain possible. External-effect safety is not claimed; adoption, public, persistent, multi-user, sensitive-data, and write-capable operation are blocked.

findings.title: Public release readiness is not established
findings.resolution: The readiness oracle now requires licensing ratification, notices, SBOM, review approval, protected approval, and reproducibility evidence. Those artifacts are deliberately absent or blocked, so public packaging cannot proceed.

findings.title: External effects and secret exfiltration are not technically denied
findings.resolution: A narrow clean environment reduces ambient leakage, but host-readable files and shared network remain. Dedicated secret-free isolation is mandatory for development and all broader operating modes are blocked.

findings.title: Signed genomes are not bound to executions
findings.resolution: A current signed genome verified with an explicitly pinned key is mandatory for execute; its digest, key id, generation time, worker version, worker fingerprint, and approved plan digest are bound into the run evidence.

findings.title: The final v0.2 acceptance oracle can false-pass
findings.resolution: The oracle requires exact checked gates and evidence and emits a source digest; the final gate runner independently re-executes every declared check.
